open_points.subject: non-inheritance of configuration and credential file descriptors
open_points.text: “No descriptor so opened is inherited by a process the kernel starts.”
open_points.question: Which module owns and enforces this guarantee: `installation`, which opens the configuration and credential paths, or `sandbox`, which owns process launch and descriptor inheritance?
options: `installation` marks or closes every such descriptor before returning
`sandbox` allows inheritance only for its explicitly passed runner descriptors
Both modules enforce complementary parts under an explicit contract
open_points.default_guess: `installation` owns making its descriptors non-inheritable, while `sandbox` owns the explicit allowlist of descriptors passed to child processes.
